source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("gig work" OR "gig workers" OR "gig economy") AND (city OR cities OR urban OR spatial OR geography)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("gig work" OR "gig workers" OR "gig economy") AND (city OR cities OR urban OR spatial OR geography),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("gig economy" OR "gig work" OR "gig workers") AND ("cities" OR "city" OR "geography" OR "spatial" OR "urban"))
